name: 77536 · Deer Park, TX
findings: ZIP 77536 (Deer Park) has 84 nonprofit organizations. 31 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 22 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 77536 (Deer Park) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
48% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
